negative_cases.description: Empty prev_scenarios slice must be rejected with EMPTY_SCENARIOS
13 curr_scenarios (> MAX_SCENARIOS_PER_SIDE=12) must be rejected with TOO_MANY_SCENARIOS
Duplicate cluster_id=0 in prev_scenarios must be rejected with DUPLICATE_SCENARIO_ID at prev_index=1
Scenario with empty mean_features must be rejected with EMPTY_FEATURES
Inconsistent feature lengths across scenarios in prev_scenarios must be rejected with RAGGED_FEATURES
NaN feature token in curr_scenarios[0].mean_features[1] must be rejected with NON_FINITE_INPUT
Negative spatial weight must be rejected with INVALID_WEIGHTS at feature_index=1
Negative threshold (-0.5) must be rejected with INVALID_THRESHOLD
Zero prev_dispersion in scaled mode must be rejected with ZERO_DISPERSION
Extreme feature magnitudes (1e200 vs -1e200) overflow squared difference to +Inf and must be rejected with NUMERICAL_FAILURE
Scenario with member_count == 0 must be rejected with ZERO_MEMBER_SCENARIO at prev_index=0
Scenario with member_fraction <= 0.0 must be rejected with INVALID_MEMBER_FRACTION at prev_index=1
Scenario with member_fraction > 1.0 must be rejected with INVALID_MEMBER_FRACTION at curr_index=0
Scenario fractions summing to 0.95 (deviation 0.05 > fraction_sum_tolerance=1e-9) must be rejected with INVALID_FRACTION_SUM
EvolutionConfig with fraction_sum_tolerance=0.01 (> 1e-3 max allowed) or negative uncertainty ratio must be rejected with INVALID_EVOLUTION_CONFIG
BackboneAssertion containing primary link (0, 1) with distance d=3.5 > threshold=2.0 must be rejected with INVALID_PRIMARY_LINK
BackboneAssertion violating 1-to-1 matching (prev 0 linked to both curr 0 and curr 1) must be rejected with INVALID_PRIMARY_LINK
Feasible 1-to-1 BackboneAssertion [(0,1),(1,0)] (sum=7.0) fails global optimality vs [(0,0),(1,1)] (sum=1.0) and must be rejected with BACKBONE_INCONSISTENCY
BackboneAssertion with tampered distance_matrix[0][0]=0.25 (actual 0.5) must be rejected with BACKBONE_INCONSISTENCY at (prev_index=0, curr_index=0)

pure_morphology_drift_series.description: 4 steps with strictly increasing weighted-RMSE shift [0.125, 0.25, 0.50, 0.875] while member_count and member_fraction remain identical ([0.625, 0.375]); verifies exact 0.0 fraction delta/TV and constant attributed_flow

pair_cases.description: Two well-separated scenarios continue 1-to-1 with moderate drift and clean margins
Single parent scenario splits into primary child (d=0.4) and secondary split child (d=0.8)
Two predecessor scenarios merge into one successor (primary d=0.3, secondary_merge d=0.9)
Rectangular 2->3: branch 0 splits (P=0.6 < Q=0.7 exercising proportional scaling + unattributed inflow) while branch 1 continues
Rectangular 3->2: {prev 0, prev 1} merge into curr 0 (Q=0.6 < P=0.8 exercising proportional merge scaling + unattributed outflow) while prev 2 continues
Unselected prev c1 is feasible to both curr c0 (d=1.0) and curr c1 (d=1.9); nearest_feasible_v1 attaches to c0 and exposes secondary_margin=0.9
Simultaneous merge ({0,1}->0) and split (2->{1,2}) on disjoint branches in a 3->3 transition

3->3 crossover diamond where inactive feasible cross-edge (0->1, d=1.95 near tau=2.0) coexists with split (0->{0,2}) and merge ({1,2}->1); verifies Berge Theorem 2 & Theorem 4 active vs raw threshold margin
2->2 transition with 1 continuation (0->0), 1 disappearance (prev 1), and 1 emergence (curr 1)
All pairwise distances exceed tau=1.0; yields 0 edges, 2 disappearances, 2 emergences, TV=1.0, and all finite metrics
Absolute threshold tau=1.5 where secondary split edge has exact d == tau (1.5), verifying inclusive <= boundary and near_threshold flag
Scale-free absolute threshold tau=0.0 (R=None): exact match d==0.0 continues with edge_strength=1.0 and near_threshold high_uncertainty, non-zero diff becomes disappearance+emergence
Single scenario splits 1->3 into 1 primary child and 2 secondary_split children
Four predecessor scenarios merge 4->1 into a single successor (1 primary + 3 secondary_merge edges)
Symmetric 2x2 square with optima_count=2: canonical order resolves (0->0, 1->1) and flags ambiguous_tie=true, optimality_margin=0.0

Unique primary optimum (optima_count=1) while unselected curr c2 is equidistant (d=2.0) to prev c0 ([4.0]) and prev c1 ([0.0]); canonical_scenario_order picks prev c1 ([0.0], canonical_rank=0) over smaller cluster_id=0 and marks secondary edge ambiguous_tie=true

Combined 6-island multi-channel bracketing pair (R=S=1.0, cutoff=0.10): simultaneously contrasts 0.05R (high_uncertainty=true) vs 0.15R (high_uncertainty=false) across threshold, optimality, and secondary margin channels
Isolated threshold channel at 0.05R <= 0.10R: triggers near_threshold high_uncertainty=true cleanly
Isolated threshold channel at 0.15R > 0.10R: high_uncertainty=false
Isolated optimality channel at 0.05R <= 0.10R (d1=0.40, d2=0.45): triggers near_primary_switch high_uncertainty=true
Isolated optimality channel at 0.15R > 0.10R (d1=0.40, d2=0.55): high_uncertainty=false
Isolated secondary channel at 0.05R <= 0.10R (S=2.0, d1=0.70, d2=0.80 -> sec_margin=0.10=0.05R, opt_margin>=0.70=0.35R): triggers ONLY near_secondary_switch
Isolated secondary channel at 0.15R > 0.10R (S=2.0, d1=0.60, d2=0.90 -> sec_margin=0.30=0.15R): high_uncertainty=false

Asymmetric 3x4 case with non-uniform weights exercising split (prev 0 -> curr {0,1}), continuation (prev 1 -> curr 2), disappearance (prev 2), and emergence (curr 3) across all 3!*4! = 144 permutations
Features containing IEEE-754 -0.0 alongside +0.0, verifying -0.0 -> +0.0 canonical normalization, exact 0.0 distance, and scaled vs absolute threshold parity (S=2.0, c=0.75 -> tau=1.5)
